title: Tower Semiconductor's market cap tops $20B, four years after a near-sale to Intel for $5B; shares are up ~60% over the past month and ~525% over the past year (CTech)
summary: CTech: Tower Semiconductor's market cap tops $20B, four years after a near-sale to Intel for $5B; shares are up ~60% over the past month and ~525% over the past year — Once overlooked, the company is now central to investor expectations around AI. — Four years ago, Tower Semiconductor was nearly sold to Intel for $5 billion.
